requirements.text: Generate one complete historical Paper chain for each selected parent entry while preserving the parent's recorded execution and financial outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: Each selected entry creates exactly one deterministic child signal, paper order, paper fill, closed paper position, paper position settlement and Settled strategy run with the exact child's strategy identity.

Copied chains preserve the parent's market, selected outcome/token, side, entry price, size, stake, timestamps, settlement value, gross PnL, fee fields and Net PnL without repricing, resizing or recalculation.
Exactly 402 financial/history rows are inserted for 67 chains, followed only after complete verification by one exact completion marker; no other row is inserted, updated or deleted.

The 21 Positive chains and 20 of 46 Reset chains retain their embedded execution-intent order-book snapshots; the remaining 26 Reset chains retain only the complete recorded parent-chain evidence and are explicitly marked as such rather than receiving fabricated snapshots.
Existing strategy flags, balances, current LossDiff states, LossDiff parent events and all parent rows remain byte-for-byte unchanged by the backfill.

verification.expected: Focused PostgreSQL tests prove complete six-row chains, deterministic IDs, exact field copying, snapshot handling, idempotency, collision refusal, one-chain atomicity and unchanged states/events/flags.

requirements.text: Apply the Production history in the established gentle Polymarket mode and verify exact completion independently.
acceptanceCriteria: Apply requires the exact approved semantic digest and an exclusive dedicated advisory lock; preview never accepts apply authority and always rolls back with writes=0.

Each of 67 chains is committed in its own short READ COMMITTED transaction, with statement_timeout 15s, lock_timeout 2s and at least one second between committed batches; a separate final transaction writes the marker only after all chains verify.

Between batches, read-only checks verify fresh Running service heartbeat, empty last_error, no unexpected waiting locks, unchanged source and plan, expected exact progress and unchanged protected flags/states/events; any deviation stops before the next batch and leaves a durable resumable prefix.

Final verification confirms exactly 46 complete Reset chains and 21 complete Positive chains, 402 target rows, no partial chains or ID collisions, exact financial totals, one matching marker and zero unintended changes.

The operation uses the local verified .NET command against Production without deploying or restarting the running service and completes repository tests, build, requirement gates, independent semantic review, task-only commits and push.

deviations.text: Twenty-six selected Reset 3+ parent chains predate embedded execution-intent order-book snapshots. Their child history will copy the complete settled parent signal/order/fill/position/settlement/run evidence but cannot independently prove the historical book from a missing snapshot; no snapshot will be invented.
deviations.impact: These 26 rows remain valid reproductions of recorded parent Paper outcomes and fees, but their market-depth evidence is limited to the persisted parent chain. The limitation does not affect any Positive 16+ chain or the other 20 Reset 3+ chains.
